items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and Papa Joe just like he spelled it. Freo Poverisher. And your mother was Alice? [INTERVIEWEE] Alice Poverisher.

ctx.x: F-E-R-E-O-L, and Papa Joe just like he spelled it. Freo Poverisher. And your mother was Alice?
Alice Poverisher. Alice Poverisher. Alice Poverisher.
